I had a lovely day here today - I’ve never had my teeth whitened before and it’s something I’ve always thought about doing when back home in the 🇬🇧.

However upon researching I found BIDC in Bangkok and decided to go ahead with the treatment here.

Upon arrival I was given the correct forms  to read through and I also had Fern next to me to help me fill out the form if needed - all the staff were very lovely and friendly to me.

My dentist properly cleaned my teeth ( I love the feel off this) and communicated anything he noticed with my teeth first!

He spoke to me about what colour my teeth already were and assessed with a tooth colour chart.

He mentioned how they would “lighten” rather than “whiten” as I think I already had pretty white teeth naturally - however I had gained a bit of tea stains over the years and it was something I wanted to remove. 🫖 ☕️

He also spoke great English and was welcoming - therefore we could communicate easily. This was a huge bonus for me coming from the 🇬🇧 !

The dental assistant was also great and always checked in to see how I felt and whether it was too sensitive and to put my hand up if I wanted to stop at any point which is really important.

The actual mall where it is located is super modern and clean. Stylish toilets too!

Im super happy with the results and Im currently trying to avoid any heavily staining foods for 2 days - so far I do have some tingling however this is normal at the beginning.

I can’t wait to show them off properly in a few days time - over some tasty food with friends, thankyou !! 🦷
